brief:
Pro-Israel groups denounced a 30-second advertisement highlighting US taxpayer funding for Israel as "antisemitic Hamas propaganda," Middle East Eye reported. The spot aired Wednesday night during a Thanksgiving special edition of a long-running sketch program broadcast across the United States.

The groups did not elaborate on specific claims in the advertisement or explain which elements they deemed antisemitic or propagandistic. The ad's content and the groups' detailed objections remain unclear from available reporting.

title: Pro-Israel groups attack US Gaza funding advertisement as antisemitic
